args.command: echo '=== codex ==='; /usr/local/bin/codex login status 2>&1 || true; echo '=== chatgpt process ==='; pgrep -a -f '(^|/)chatgpt( |$)' || true; echo '=== chatgpt state dirs ==='; find /root/.config /root/.local/share -maxdepth 2 -type d \( -iname '*chatgpt*' -o -iname '*openai*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -40 || true; echo '=== package ==='; dpkg-query -W -f='${Status} ${Version}\n' chatgpt 2>/dev/null || true

meta.summary: Verify Codex CLI login and whether ChatGPT Linux app has its own active session
